title: Super Mario Kart

masks.why: the title screen's logo is laid out for 256 columns on a 32-tile map that would repeat (BG1 map at $1000)

issues: Both Mode 7 views (the track and the course map, or the two players' tracks) continue to both edges; the hills behind repeat seamlessly.
Sprites are filled in the sides: the game places the karts, shadows and items it does not show around the SNES picture, so rivals appear only in the centre 256 columns.
The title screen is shown with black sides.
